name: basera-desktop
description: Desktop app for Basera (Windows, macOS, Linux)
author: Basera

scripts.build:win: npm run prepare-app && electron-builder --win --x64 && node checksums.mjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare-app && electron-builder --mac dmg && node checksums.mjs
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare-app && electron-builder --linux AppImage && node checksums.mjs
